name: Pavinetant
summary: Pavinetant, is a small-molecule, orally active, selective neurokinin-3 (NK3) receptor antagonist which was under development by AstraZeneca and Millendo Therapeutics for the treatment of hot flashes and polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS). It was also under investigation for the treatment of schizophrenia, but development was discontinued for this indication due to lack of effectiveness.

pharmacology.text: Pavinetant (INN, USAN; developmental code names MLE-4901, AZD-4901, AZ-12472520, AZD-2624), is a small-molecule, orally active, selective neurokinin-3 (NK3) receptor antagonist which was under development by AstraZeneca and Millendo Therapeutics for the treatment of hot flashes and polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS).

uses.text: Pavinetant (INN, USAN; developmental code names MLE-4901, AZD-4901, AZ-12472520, AZD-2624), is a small-molecule, orally active, selective neurokinin-3 (NK3) receptor antagonist which was under development by AstraZeneca and Millendo Therapeutics for the treatment of hot flashes and polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS).

sideEffects.en: Its development was stopped after signs of liver injury appeared in trials.
sideEffects.zh: 在試驗中出現肝損傷徵象後，它的研發被中止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在试验中出现肝损伤征象后，它的研发被中止。

fact.en: It was tested for hot flushes in menopause, after work on the brain's kisspeptin and neurokinin B circuit suggested those nerve cells act as the body's thermostat.
fact.zh: 它曾被用於更年期熱潮紅的試驗。對大腦 kisspeptin 與神經激素 B 迴路的研究顯示，那些神經細胞就像人體的恆溫器。
fact.zhHans: 它曾被用于更年期热潮红的试验。对大脑 kisspeptin 与神经激素 B 回路的研究显示，那些神经细胞就像人体的恒温器。
